Ellen M: Quick ask — CloudPartnerY requested a 60m enablement for their SI partners next Tue. Goal: walk ref-arch, Terraform starter module, and marketplace packaging. Who can own the sections?
Tomas R: I can take ref-arch + marketplace packaging. Will prepare topology diagram, security callouts, and an example asset manifest.
Ivy K: I'll own the Terraform starter module and live demo. Plan: minimal network -> instance -> runtime config. Demo flow: git clone -> terraform init/plan/apply -> smoke test.
Ellen M: Please add a 5m slide on private deployment and KMS. Partners usually ask about key handling and VPC peering.
Tomas R: Will add a concise IAM least-privilege snippet and audit-log notes. Also include a checklist for marketplace submission (icons, manifest, support contact).
Ivy K: Terraform snippet we'll demo:
```hcl
module "cpty_inference" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/partner-refkits//cloudpartnery/terraform/starter"
  region = var.region
  instance_type = "g5.xlarge"
  enable_private_vpc = true
  kms_key_arn = var.kms_key_arn
}
```
Ellen M: Can infra spin up a short-lived sandbox for the rehearsal? Prefer creds expire after 48h.
infra-bot: Demo sandbox created: cp-y-demo-2025-06-10. Credentials expiry: 48h. Rehearsal scheduled: 2025-06-09 16:00 UTC. Repo checklist: https://git.internal/redwood/partner-refkits/cloudpartnery/enablement-checklist.md
Ivy K: I'll push the starter module, README, and a smoke test script under tests/smoke/ by EOD tomorrow. Will include troubleshooting notes (security groups, firewall, model pull auth).
Tomas R: I'll draft the asset manifest example and marketplace submission checklist and open a PR.
Ellen M: Owners set: Tomas (ref-arch + marketplace), Ivy (terraform + tests), Ellen (coord + slides). We'll rehearse 24h before. Post PR links here when ready. :rocket:
